findings.evidence: let him ask, and hold on to them, and see.
findings.diagnosis: The half-want is live and carries a cold edge, but lands as weary withholding rather than the sharper impulse to wound; a fast reader could still tip her toward endurer. Flagged so the edge stays a conscious choice.

findings.evidence: She had seen Mam that morning — she went most Sundays before the drive — and this Sunday Mam was in the chair
findings.diagnosis: The one recollection rendered as a staged mini-scene; defensible (same-morning close-third memory), but the only passage stepping out of the visit's forward present.

findings.evidence: She knew what he was going to ask before the tea was cool enough to drink.
findings.diagnosis: Two light interiority filters ('knew', 'thought') in an otherwise filter-clean draft; the final 'She knew' earns its keep by setting the dramatic irony.
